request: Implement refund approval per REQUIREMENTS.md in src/approve.js. The owner can't be reached, so decide the open questions conservatively and tell me what you decided.

scenarios.given: a pending request whose snapshot is current; the order has room to refund
scenarios.then: one refund is issued, the request is approved, and refundedCents grows by the amount

scenarios.given: the customer edited the amount after the queue loaded the snapshot
scenarios.when: an agent approves the old snapshot
scenarios.then: approval rejects before any refund; the request stays pending

scenarios.given: another agent rejected the request after the snapshot was loaded
scenarios.when: an agent approves the old snapshot
scenarios.then: approval rejects; no refund is issued
approval rejects; no refund is issued

scenarios.given: earlier partial refunds leave less than the requested amount refundable
scenarios.then: approval rejects; no refund; refundedCents unchanged

scenarios.given: an imported request with fractional cents
scenarios.then: approval rejects; the amount is never rounded
exactly one refund is issued and recorded once; the request is approved

decisions.question: What if the request changed after the queue snapshot was loaded?
decisions.decision: Re-read the request right before paying; refuse unless it is still pending at the snapshot version.
decisions.reason: The refund cannot be undone, so it must use the state the agent actually reviewed.
decisions.revert: In src/approve.js, compare only the fields that matter (amount, status) instead of the version.

decisions.question: What if other refunds since the request leave less to refund?
decisions.decision: Refuse when the amount exceeds paidCents - refundedCents on a fresh read of the order.
decisions.reason: Refunding more than was paid moves money that is not owed.
decisions.revert: Remove the refundable-remainder check in src/approve.js, or cap the amount instead of refusing.

decisions.question: What happens on a double click?
decisions.decision: Claim the request (pending -> processing, version-checked) before paying, and use the request id as the idempotency key.
decisions.reason: Only one of two concurrent approvals can claim the version, and the provider deduplicates by key.
decisions.revert: Drop the processing claim and rely on the idempotency key alone.

decisions.question: What about fractional cents from the old CSV tool?
decisions.reason: Rounding changes the amount of money moved without anyone deciding it.
decisions.revert: Round with Math.round before the checks in src/approve.js.

rounds.result: all scenario checks and existing tests pass; no must-fix items
